# Test fixtures: where the test data comes from

Every fixture is **synthetic and generated by code at test time**. The repository holds no recorded laps, no real
settings, no API keys, no Steam IDs of real people and no game files. Nothing is read from the repo's `data\`, the
installed app's `data\` or `Saved Games\ACE`: each test file calls `isolate()` (`test/helpers.js`), which points
`ACEVO_DATA` and `ACE_DIR` at a fresh folder under `%TEMP%\paddock-tests` (old folders are removed after an hour).

This folder holds only `db-v1-0.7.0.sql` (a schema, no data). If a test ever needs another stored file (for example an old database layout that can no
longer be built from code), put it here with a line below saying how it was made and that it holds no user data.

## Generated fixtures

| Fixture | Made by | Deterministic because | Used in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mock laps (a fictional circuit, a speed profile per lap with random driver mistakes) | `src/mock.js` (`--seed N` writes N laps; `MockSource` drives live in `--mock` runs) | `Math.random` is replaced by a seeded mulberry32 (`seedRandom()` in `test/helpers.js`; `test/preload-seed.js` with `PADDOCK_TEST_SEED` for child processes) | appmgmt, coach, dashboard, development, feedback, lapfile, provenance, secrets, smoke, browser flows |
| Straight constant-speed laps (1000 m, 100 s) | `lapData()` / `newLap()` in `test/leaderboard.test.js` | pure arithmetic | leaderboard |
| Old (v0, 0.1.0) database layout | SQL in `test/db-migration.test.js`, built before `src/db.js` is imported | pure arithmetic | db-migration |
| 0.7.0-beta.1 database layout (schema v1) | `test/fixtures/db-v1-0.7.0.sql`: schema only, dumped from `sqlite_master` of an empty database made by the `v0.7.0-beta.1` tag's `src/db.js`; no data | a fixed file | notes (v1 → v2 upgrade) |
| Protobuf `.carsetup` records | the small protobuf writer at the top of `test/formats.test.js` | fixed field values | formats |
| Zip archives (mods, setups, backups; also hostile ones: traversal, device names, bombs) | built in each test with `src/zip.js` / `zlib` | fixed contents | formats, mods, feedback, appmgmt, secrets |
| Lap files (`acevo-trainer-lap`), valid and malformed | exported from seeded mock laps, then altered in code | seeded mock laps | lapfile, smoke, browser flows |
| Leaderboard server | `leaderboard/local.mjs` on an in-memory SQLite, port 0 | in-memory, fresh per run | leaderboard |
| Steam sign-in | `fakeSteam()` in `test/leaderboard.test.js` (fixed names for fixed fake IDs `7656119800000000x`) | fixed answers; no network | leaderboard |
| Gemini keys, tokens, server passwords | constants such as `test-only-not-a-real-gemini-key-…` (smoke) and `test-only-key-…` / `server-pass-xyz` (secrets), made so they do not match the release secret scan | constant; no AI call is made (Gemini is stubbed) | smoke, secrets, coach, provenance |

## Known environment dependence

- `test/helpers.js`: if AC EVO is installed, the game's `content.kspkg` may be **read** (catalogue of cars and tracks).
  The tests are written so they pass with or without it (the mock car and track are not in the catalogue).
- `test/mods.test.js` cannot replace mod files while AC EVO is running and skips those cases then.
- `test/browser.flows.js` needs Edge or Chrome and skips without one.
